title: Xu Zizhi tongjian changbian (Long Draft Continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror), juan 101

lineage: Southern Song retrospective annals. Li Dao compares sources and gives precedence to the Chengdu ji on the disputed roles of officials.

passages.locator: Juan 101, Tiansheng 1, eleventh month, wuwu (戊午)
passages.note: The annals connect private bills to the weight of Sichuan iron cash and report defaults and repeated lawsuits. In the intervening text the court directs Xue Tian and Transport Commissioner Zhang Ruogu to weigh the merits after Kou Jian sought abolition. The two argue that abolishing jiaozi would inconvenience trade and request a public office and a ban on private issue. They reaffirm the recommendation after consulting a judicial official from Zizhou Circuit. The court accepts and establishes the office on the wuwu day.
passages.quote: 初蜀民以鐡錢重私為券謂之交子以便貿易……不能償所負爭訟數起……田若谷議廢交子不復用則貿易非便但請官為置務禁民私造……戊午詔從其請始置益州交子務
